final_text:
Done — the game works and the smoke test is clean.

**Files** (all relative, static, in `games/2-runner/`):
- `index.html` — page + the exact three.js 0.170.0 jsDelivr import map + HTML overlay (score, speed, best, lane, state, last action, game-over panel)
- `style.css`, `main.js` (renderer/scene/camera/light/fog/loop), `game.js` (state machine, speed ramp, scoring, collisions, input), `player.js` (lane tween + jump physics + run animation), `spawner.js` (pooled obstacles + spawn rules), `track.js` (recycled scrolling lane dashes and posts), `hud.js`, `rng.js`
- `README.md` — what it is, controls, how it works

**Verified with headless Chromium** (`node ../tools/smoke.ts . --keys "ArrowLeft:500,Space:100" --click 0.5,0.5`):
- no console/page/request errors, 60 fps in SwiftShader
- overlay reacts: `LANE 2 → LANE 1` after ArrowLeft, `LAST jump` after Space/click, score climbs 60 → 95, `PASSED 1` proves a hurdle was cleared by jumping
- a longer run confirmed a crash (`STATE crashed`, `LAST hit crate`, game-over panel with score/best) and that Space restarts with best score kept in `localStorage`
- spawn rules guarantee a passable pattern: crates (1.9 m) can't be jumped (jump apex ≈ 1.6 m), and all-three-lane patterns are always jumpable hurdles.

**Cause** — `track.js` built the whole track (road plane, ground plane, instanced lane dashes, side posts) into a `THREE.Group` and returned it, but never added that group to the scene. `main.js` does `const track = createTrack(scene)` and only uses `track.update(move)`, so every mesh in the track stayed outside the scene graph and was never rendered — only the player and obstacles (which *are* added via `scene.add` in `player.js`/`spawner.js`) drew on top of `scene.background`. No error was reported because nothing was wrong at runtime, the group was simply orphaned.

Confirmed from the pre-fix screenshot pixel analysis (my own PNG reader + PIL): the frame was ~88 % pure background `16,20,24` plus a few hundred text/pixel specks — no road/ground/dash colors at all.

**Fix** — `games/2-runner/track.js`:

```js
export function createTrack(scene) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  // The group was never added to the scene, so the whole track (road, ground,
  // dashes, posts) was invisible and only the player/obstacles rendered.
  scene.add(group);
```

**Retest** (`node ../tools/smoke.ts . --keys "ArrowLeft:500,Space:100" --click 0.5,0.5`): exit 0, no console/page/request errors, no warnings, 60 fps idle and 60 fps while playing in SwiftShader, overlay still reacts (`LANE 2 → 1`, `LAST jump`, `PASSED 1`, score 60 → 95).

Pixel analysis of the new screenshots shows the track is now drawn and scrolling — lower half went from `dash=398 post=185` (all background) to `dash=2517 post=385` with the road/ground trapezoid present, and the dash/post pattern differs between the start and input screenshots, i.e. the world is moving past the camera:

```
y=400  ......-.---------###---------......      (start)
y=400  .........###-------------#----########...  (after input)
```

Files changed: `track.js` only.
